note: Cast-color button labels — the wiring spec for iOS / Android / web (see README.md).

rules.fit: Label area = the flat middle only, inset from each end by max(capInset × height, minPad). Shrink the font from fontOfHeight × height down to minFontPt; if it still does not fit, the button grows wider. Text never touches the caps.
rules.strokeAndShadow: Stroke = the deeper SAME-hue color below (one outline, drawn under the white fill; no grey, no white edge, no second offset outline). Shadow = the same color, soft drop.
rules.artLabelSizing: Label ART (buttons/labels/<slug>.png) renders at the SAME cap height on every button: 0.42 x the button height (the image height is the cap height). The button widens to fit (label width + 2 x max(0.6 x height, 14 pt @44)). Only if the button cannot widen (a fixed-width slot) does the label shrink, keeping the 0.6 x height inset. Never scale a label up to fill.
rules.artLabelShadow: Under the label art: its alpha tinted in the color's shadow, 1 pt down, blurred, at shadowAlpha x 1.6 (all colors).

artHalo.note: gold only: a deeper amber halo behind the cream label (cream on gold is the faintest pair)
